audit.method: Read from the full term sheet by one AI reviewer, then checked against it twice by independent AI reviewers: first every line of the record against the document, then the document section by section against the record. Not signed off by a person. Every quote is looked up in the PDF text each time the tool runs.
audit.open_points:
Final record: C:\Users\AFarid\Documents\Hackathon\key_credit_terms\data\audited\capri_2026.json. Checker: structure OK, 80 quotes exact, 0 loose, 0 on another page, 0 missing. A field-by-field diff against .cache\audit1\capri_2026.json shows only the four changes listed. All 14 page images were read against the dump; the layout is a plain two-column term sheet with proposed terms only (no existing / proposed columns), and the dump matches the images.

Reverse walk result: no wrong or transposed figure and no term sitting under the wrong facility, covenant or period. Every number in the record was traced to its clause, including the two uses of 4.00x (maintenance covenant on page 7; incurrence test for unsecured Permitted Equivalent Indebtedness on page 4), 3.00x (Secured Net Leverage incurrence test only), 4.50x step-up, $400m / 100% of EBITDA, $200m cash netting, 15% cap, 18 / 12 months, 105%, 5 and 10 business days, $5m. No not_stated or by_reference field was upgraded: searches for Barclays, budget, projections, 'days after', annual, audited, post-closing, disqualified, competitor, sub-limit, cure, hoarding and most-favoured-nation found nothing beyond what the record already reports.

First auditor's doubts, as resolved:
1. Ranking line 2 (from Voting) kept, reworded. It is still a judgement call the document cannot settle: the template has no voting row, and the other audited records keep Ranking to a single line. Deleting the line loses nothing elsewhere except this lender protection.
2. select_definitions kept in the four-prefix form (the brief puts cash netting and the leverage definition under 'Adjusted EBITDA: '); that line is 386 characters.
3. transferability line 1 left at 416 characters (hard limit 420); the brief puts all consent terms and minimum amounts on the first line.
4. info_annual_obligor left not_stated, following the field guidance; this is also how the row is treated in the other audited records where the reporting covenant points to an existing agreement. Under the style guide's open-list rule it could equally be by_reference, since the 'financial statements and other information' covenant is 'substantially the same as the Existing Credit Agreement'.
5. events_of_default and permitted_indebtedness left by_reference: the thresholds and general baskets those rows ask for are only in the Existing Credit Agreement, although the 5 business day grace period and the incremental-equivalent debt capacity are stated.
6. mandatory_prepayment keeps the line reporting silence on disposal / insurance / debt issuance / excess cashflow prepayments, because the template prompt names those heads.

Not resolvable from the term sheet:
- Date: 'Posting Version 6/5/2026' is kept as printed; the document does not fix the day / month order (5 June or 6 May 2026).
- The opening paragraph says that, unless otherwise set forth, the facility has the same terms as the Existing Credit Agreement. Rows reported as not stated (conditions subsequent, guarantor coverage test, obligor accounts) and the prepayment heads the term sheet is silent on may therefore be governed by that agreement.
- Defined only in the Existing Credit Agreement: Material Acquisition, Secured Net Leverage Ratio, the change of control trigger, material-subsidiary thresholds, letter of credit and swing line sub-limits, the base Consolidated EBITDAR definition, 'eligible assignees'. The jurisdiction of Capri Holdings Limited is not given.
- Blanks in the term sheet: second Joint Lead Arranger, Syndication Agent, the annual asset sale basket amount and the EBITDA grower percentage. Barclays is not named.
- 24 lines exceed the 250-character soft guide (longest 416, under the 420 limit).

doc.title: $1,000 MILLION REVOLVING CREDIT FACILITY - Summary of Terms and Conditions
doc.notes: Summary of Terms and Conditions (posting version) for a $1,000 million senior secured revolving credit facility for Michael Kors (USA), Inc., Capri Holdings Limited and other group borrowers, with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. as Administrative Agent and Joint Lead Arranger. The main terms are on pages 1-10; Annex I (interest and certain fees) is on pages 11-13 and Annex I-A (pricing grid) on page 14. The facility is to be documented as an amendment to the Existing Credit Agreement (Amended and Restated Credit Agreement dated February 4, 2025); the term sheet shows the proposed terms only (no existing / proposed columns) and says that, unless otherwise set forth, the terms are the same as the Existing Credit Agreement, so covenant baskets, default thresholds and reporting deadlines are given by reference only. The second Joint Lead Arranger and the Syndication Agent are left blank and no lender commitments are shown. Terms shown that have no row in the template: pricing (Applicable Rate initially 1.25% for Term Benchmark Loans and 0.25% for ABR Loans and commitment fee initially 0.15%, then by the Annex I-A grid on the Net Leverage Ratio: 112.5-150.0 bps, 12.5-50.0 bps and 10.0-20.0 bps respectively; Term SOFR floor 0%), the default rate (2% above the otherwise applicable rate), voting (Required Lenders: more than 50%), and the replacement-of-lender and defaulting-lender provisions (both by reference to the Existing Credit Agreement).
